0022600171.text: The Toronto Raptors (3-2, 5th in the East, coming off a loss) visit the LA Clippers (1-4, 13th in the West, on a four-game losing streak), with Toronto missing Jakob Poeltl (shoulder inflammation), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture). The Clippers are also without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery). The Raptors lost both meetings with the Clippers in the 2025-26 season, most recently 119-94 in Los Angeles on March 25, 2026.
